summary: BC Partners Lending Corp filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing that shareholders of Alternative Credit Income Fund approved the merger of BCPL Merger Sub, Inc. into ACIF, with ACIF surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of BCPL. Approximately 84.6% of voting shareholders supported the proposal. Following the merger, ACIF will merge into BCPL. Concurrently, ACIF is conducting a one-time discretionary repurchase offer for up to 15% of its outstanding shares. No price per share, premium, or closing date was disclosed. Watch for completion timing, repurchase uptake, and integration risk.
